text:
Lena: Creston procurement asked for a compact SLO insert for onboarding docs. They want uptime, p99 latency, and a sample credit calc they can copy into the contract. Need quick alignment.
Priya (Creston): Timeline tight 1 review with legal Wednesday. For trial/procurement they prefer p99 <= 350ms and an expected uptime of 99.95% for the packet.
Diego: For onboarding packets we sometimes show a shorter measurement window (14d rolling) to reflect the ramp. Propose we show both 14d and 30d snapshots and note the standard contract uses 30d rolling.
Maya: I'll assemble the one-pager. Which credit formula should we present? We can show the hosted baseline but note Dedicated/Private get custom terms.
Lena: Use hosted baseline but call out the 14d example is illustrative only. Canonical formula (hosted): credit = max(0, ((SLA - achieved) / SLA) * committed_amount) capped per contract.
Diego: Worked example for the packet (14d illustrative): sla=0.9995, achieved=0.9988, commitment=$75,000 -> credit=((0.9995-0.9988)/0.9995)*75000 ~ $525. Pasteable snippet: ```sla=0.9995\nachieved=0.9988\ncommitment=75000\ncredit=max(0,(sla-achieved)/sla*commitment)```
SLO-bot: Snapshot: creston-crst-221 14d uptime=99.88%, 30d uptime=99.92%, p99 latency=390ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/crst-221/slo :information_source:
Priya (Creston): Excellent. Procurement also wants a short note on fallback behavior and what it means for latency/quality. Keep it 2 sentences.
Diego: Suggested 2-line note: "If capacity constraints occur, requests may be routed to compatible model variants or fall back to CPU-backed workers to preserve availability. This keeps services online but can increase tail latency or slightly alter output characteristics; customers are notified via incident/tracking links."
Maya: Action items: I'll draft the one-pager with 14d/30d snapshots, include the worked calc, SLO snapshot link and the fallback blurb. Lena/Diego to review. ETA: Thursday EOD.
Lena: Sounds good. Priya, does that timeline work for procurement review?
Priya (Creston): Thursday EOD is perfect, thanks. We'll review with legal on Wednesday then finalize.
Diego: Quick note for ops: let's ensure the 14d data is visible on the shared dashboard view so procurement sees both windows.
SLO-bot: Reminder: next auto-snapshot runs in 6h.
Maya: Got it, will send draft when ready. :thumbsup:
